item.title: Love them, but let them go
item.description: by Anonymous I love basketball, and I love the Blazers, but honestly folks, if we have 600 million dollars to spend we need to spend that money on schools, and housing people. It will be painful to see them leave, but it's the right decision based on real economic data, not the convoluted logic that a low rent Texas wheeler dealer is presenting us with. We can create a prosperous, livable city that sports teams with owner integrity and a moral compass will beg to be in. Love and Peace.
